description: Cross-platform SearchMatcher parity fixtures. Each case runs SearchMatcher.search(query, ContentStore.searchIndex) and asserts: at least `minExpectedResultCount` results, AND (if present) some result's document id CONTAINS `mustContainDocId`, AND (if present) some result's document type equals `mustMatchType`. Mirror copy lives at android/app/src/test/resources/search_query_golden.json — keep them identical.
